passages.text: Overview Company Overview At Kenvue, our purpose is to realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. As a global leader at the intersection of healthcare and consumer goods, we are the world’s largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue with $15.1 billion in Net sales in the fiscal year 2025. By combining the power of science with meaningful consumer insights and our digital strategy, we empower consumers to live healthier lives every day. Built on more than a century of heritage and trusted by generations, our differentiated portfolio of iconic brands—including Aveeno ® , BAND-AID ® Brand, Johnson’s ® , Listerine ® , Neutrogena ® , Nicorette ® , Tylenol ® , and Zyrtec ® —is backed by science and recommended by healthcare professionals, which further reinforces our consumers’ connections to our brands. Our portfolio includes Self Care, Skin Health and Beauty, and Essential Health products, allowing us to connect with consumers globally in their daily rituals and the moments that matter most. Our global scale and the breadth of our brand portfolio are complemented by our well-developed capabilities and accelerated through our digital strategy, allowing us to dynamically capitalize on and respond to current trends impacting our categories and geographic markets. With a sole focus on consumer health, our marketing organization operates efficiently by leveraging our precision marketing, e-commerce, and broader digital capabilities to develop unique consumer insights and further enhance the relevance of our brands. Similarly, our research and development organization combines these consumer insights with deep, multi-disciplinary scientific expertise, and active engagement with healthcare professionals, to drive innovative new products, solutions, and experiences centered around consumer health. Our Business Segments We operate our business through the following three reportable business segments: • Self Care. Our Self Care product categories include: Cough, Cold, and Allergy; Pain Care; and Other Self Care (Digestive Health, Smoking Cessation, Eye Care, and Other). Major brands in the segment include Benadryl ® , Calpol ® , Motrin ® , Nicorette ® , Rhinocort ® , Tylenol ® , Zarbee’s ® , and Zyrtec ® . • Skin Health and Beauty. Our Skin Health and Beauty product categories include: Face and Body Care; and Hair, Sun, and Other. Major brands in the segment include Aveeno ® , Dr.Ci:Labo ® , Le Petit Marseillais ® , Lubriderm ® , Neutrogena ® , OGX ® , and Rogaine ® . • Essential Health. Our Essential Health product categories include: Oral Care; Baby Care; and Other Essential Health (Women’s Health, Wound Care, and Other). Major brands in the segment include BAND-AID ® Brand, Carefree ® , Desitin ® , Johnson’s ® , Listerine ® , o.b. ® tampons, and Stayfree ® . For additional information about our three reportable business segments, see Note 18 , “Segments of Business and Geographic Areas , ” to the Consolidated Financial Statements included herein . passages.text: Summary of Risk Factors The following is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in Kenvue speculative or risky: Risks Related to the Proposed Transaction with K-C • If the Proposed Transaction is consummated, the combined company may not perform as expected and may fail to realize the projected benefits and cost savings of the Proposed Transaction, which could adversely affect the value of K-C common stock, which our current shareholders will own following the completion of the Proposed Transaction. • Failure to consummate, or a delay in the consummation of, the Proposed Transaction. • Uncertainties associated with the Proposed Transaction may cause a loss of management and other key employees. • Our shareholders will have a significantly reduced ownership and voting interest in the combined company. • Litigation against us or K-C, or the members of our or K-C’s board of directors. • The Merger Agreement restricts our ability to pursue alternatives to the Proposed Transaction. • Regulatory approvals may delay the Proposed Transaction or may diminish its benefits. • The number of shares of K-C common stock issuable in the First Merger in respect of one share of our common stock is fixed and will not be adjusted. Because the market price of K-C common stock may fluctuate, our shareholders cannot be sure of the market value of the stock consideration they will receive in exchange for their shares. • If the Proposed Transaction fails to qualify as a “reorganization” within the meaning of Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), our shareholders may pay additional U.S. federal income taxes. • Uncertainties associated with the Proposed Transaction may disrupt our business. • The Proposed Transaction’s consummation is expected to trigger change-in-control or other provisions. • Failure to integrate our and K-C’s businesses and operations successfully in the expected time frame. • The Merger Agreement restricts certain business activities prior to the effective time of the Proposed Transaction. • We have incurred, and will continue to incur, significant costs in connection with the Proposed Transaction. • The Proposed Transaction may result in a loss of customers, distributors, service providers, suppliers, vendors, joint venture participants, and other business counterparties and may result in the termination of existing contracts. credit_strengths.text: Kenvue's portfolio of iconic consumer health brands, including Tylenol and Listerine, generates substantial recurring revenue and operating cash flow. The company holds a leading pure-play position in consumer health, which supports pricing power and cash generation through economic cycles, as evidenced by its annual revenue and operating cash flow.

Profitability is solid, with an operating margin slightly above the sector median, and interest coverage comfortably exceeds the sector median. This indicates efficient operations and ample capacity to service debt from earnings, providing a cushion against margin volatility.

key_risks.text: The proposed transaction with K-C introduces significant execution and integration risks. If consummated, the combined company may fail to realize projected benefits, and uncertainties could disrupt operations, cause loss of key employees, or trigger change-in-control provisions, potentially affecting credit quality.

Debt maturities are lumpy, with a notable portion due within the next twelve months and large repayments in later years. Refinancing this profile exposes the company to interest rate and market conditions, especially given the current leverage above the sector median.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers debt service, but free cash flow to debt is below the sector median, indicating less financial flexibility. The company's cash flow tier is weaker than its leverage tier, suggesting that cash generation may be a constraint if earnings decline.

Interest coverage is adequate, with operating income covering interest expense multiple times. However, the current ratio is below one, reflecting a working capital deficit that could pressure liquidity if not managed, though this is common in the sector.

overall_credit_view.text: Kenvue's indicative financial risk profile is significant, with net leverage above the sector median and cash flow metrics weaker than peers. The company has limited headroom to a downgrade threshold, and shareholder distributions absorb most free cash flow, constraining deleveraging.

The proposed K-C transaction adds uncertainty, and the company's ability to integrate successfully is unproven. While brand strength supports cash generation, the combination of high leverage, weak cash flow, and execution risk warrants a cautious credit view, with monitoring of refinancing and integration progress.

credit_strengths.text: Kenvue旗下包括Tylenol及Listerine等標誌性消費者健康品牌組合，產生大量經常性收入及營運現金流。該公司於消費者健康領域持有領先嘅純業務地位，支持定價能力及穿越經濟週期嘅現金產生，其年度收入及營運現金流可資證明。
盈利能力穩健，營運利潤率略高於行業中位數，而利息覆蓋率舒適地超過行業中位數。呢個表明營運高效，並有充足能力以盈利償付債務，為利潤率波動提供緩衝。

key_risks.text: 擬與K-C進行嘅交易帶來重大執行及整合風險。若交易完成，合併後公司可能無法實現預期效益，而不確定性可能擾亂營運、導致關鍵員工流失，或觸發控制權變更條款，可能影響信貸質素。
債務到期不均勻，其中顯著部分於未來十二個月內到期，而後續年份有大量還款。為此狀況再融資使公司面臨利率及市場狀況風險，尤其考慮到目前槓桿高於行業中位數。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運現金流覆蓋債務償付，但自由現金流對債務比率低於行業中位數，表明財務靈活性較低。公司嘅現金流級別弱於其槓桿級別，暗示若盈利下跌，現金產生可能構成制約。
利息覆蓋率充足，營運收入覆蓋利息支出多倍。然而，流動比率低於一，反映營運資金赤字，若管理不善可能對流動性構成壓力，儘管此於行業中常見。

overall_credit_view.text: Kenvue嘅指示性財務風險狀況顯著，淨槓桿高於行業中位數，且現金流指標弱於同業。公司對降級門檻嘅緩衝有限，而股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，制約去槓桿。
擬議嘅K-C交易增添不確定性，而公司成功整合嘅能力未經證實。儘管品牌實力支持現金產生，高槓桿、疲弱現金流及執行風險嘅組合支持審慎嘅信貸觀點，並需監測再融資及整合進展。
